# What does an aeration and overseeding job really make? True profit, margin and the lowest quote

> Free bid calculator for lawn-care operators pricing aeration and overseeding: true profit, margin and the lowest quote that hits your target margin.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
